results.title: Memorial Regional Hospital (Florida) - Wikipedia
results.content:
Memorial Regional Hospital is a 797-bed public hospital located in Hollywood, Florida. The hospital is the flagship hospital of Memorial Healthcare System.

| Beds | 797 | [...] Memorial Regional Hospital is home to a Level I trauma center, the Memorial Cardiac & Vascular Institute, the Memorial Cancer Institute, and the Memorial Neuroscience Institute. The hospital also features the Dr. Henry D. Perry Family Birthplace, a labor and delivery unit. Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital is across the street and connected by skyway for transfers to its Level IV neonatal intensive care unit.

results.title: Memorial Healthcare System | Hollywood Economic Development, FL
results.content: Memorial Regional Hospital is the flagship facility of the health care system and is one of the largest hospitals in Florida. Memorial Regional Hospital offers extensive and diverse health care services that include Memorial Cardiac and Vascular Institute featuring renowned surgeons, Memorial Cancer Institute treating more inpatients than any other in Broward County, and Memorial Neuroscience Center providing innovative technology and world-class physicians. [...] Memorial Regional Hospital and Memorial Regional Hospital South are both located in Hollywood, Florida, and offer our community a variety of medical and surgical services. Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital at Memorial provides a comprehensive array of pediatric services and is the leading children's hospital in Broward and Palm Beach counties. Memorial Hospital West, Memorial Hospital Miramar and Memorial Hospital Pembroke serve the communities of western Broward County and others in South [...] Since its inception in 1953, Memorial Healthcare System has been a leader in providing high-quality healthcare services to South Florida residents. Today, it is one of the largest public health care systems in the nation and highly regarded for its exceptional patient- and family-centered care. Memorial's patient, physician and employee satisfaction rates are some of the most admired in the country, and the system is recognized as a national leader in quality health care.

results.content: Memorial Regional Hospital 3501 Johnson Street Hollywood, Florida 33021 (954) 987-2000 Memorial Regional Hospital is located at 3501 Johnson Street. The hospital is on the northwest corner of Johnson Street and North 35th Avenue, west of Interstate 95 (I-95) and east of the Florida Turnpike. Driving Directions From I-95, take the Hollywood Boulevard exit west. Make a right (north) on North 35th Avenue. The Visitor Parking Garage is one block past Johnson Street on the left. From the Florida [...] From the Florida Turnpike, take the Hollywood/Pines Boulevard exit east. Make a left (north) on North 35th Avenue. The Visitor Parking Garage is one block past Johnson Street on the left. From Interstate 75 (I-75), take the Pines Boulevard exit east. Make a left (north) on North 35th Avenue. The Visitor Parking Garage is one block past Johnson Street on the left. Parking at Memorial Regional Hospital Parking is available 24 hours a day in our five-story, covered Visitor Parking Garage. You will [...] is available in the garage across from the Emergency Department entrance, accessible from Johnson Street. Valet Service at Memorial Regional Hospital Free valet parking is available at the entrance to the Memorial Outpatient Center and the main entrance to Memorial Regional Hospital, as well as the main entrance to the Memorial Medical Office Centre, 1150 North 35th Avenue. Please park only in designated spots or use the valet service.
